URGENCY.label: Rushing you
URGENCY.detail: Pushes you to act immediately so you do not stop to check.

THREAT_BLOCK.label: Threat to block or cut a service
THREAT_BLOCK.detail: Threatens to block your account, SIM or power so you panic.

THREAT_LEGAL.label: Legal threat
THREAT_LEGAL.detail: Mentions arrest, an FIR, a warrant or a police case to scare you.

AUTHORITY_CLAIM.label: Claims to be an authority
AUTHORITY_CLAIM.detail: Uses the name of the police, a regulator or a government department.

SECRECY.label: Asks you to keep it secret
SECRECY.detail: Tells you not to tell your family or your bank.

STAY_ON_CALL.label: Keeps you on the call
STAY_ON_CALL.detail: Tells you not to hang up, or to stay on a video call.

ASKS_OTP.label: Asks for your OTP
ASKS_OTP.detail: No bank, company or officer ever needs your OTP.

ASKS_PIN.label: Asks for your PIN
ASKS_PIN.detail: Your UPI or ATM PIN is only for you, to send your own money.

ASKS_CVV_PASSWORD.label: Asks for CVV or password
ASKS_CVV_PASSWORD.detail: Real services never ask for your CVV or password.

ASKS_REMOTE_APP.label: Asks for a screen-sharing app
ASKS_REMOTE_APP.detail: Apps like AnyDesk let a stranger control your phone.

APK_LINK.label: App file (APK) to install
APK_LINK.detail: An app installed from a link can read your messages and OTPs.

RECEIVE_WITH_PIN.label: PIN to "receive" money
RECEIVE_WITH_PIN.detail: Entering your UPI PIN always sends money. You never need a PIN to receive money.

COLLECT_REQUEST.label: Collect request
COLLECT_REQUEST.detail: Approving a collect request takes money from your account.

QR_TO_RECEIVE.label: QR to "receive" money
QR_TO_RECEIVE.detail: Scanning a QR is only for paying, never for receiving.

ADVANCE_FEE.label: Asks for a fee first
ADVANCE_FEE.detail: Asks you to pay before you get a job, loan, prize or parcel.

PRIZE_LOTTERY.label: Prize or lottery
PRIZE_LOTTERY.detail: Says you won a prize or lottery you never entered.

TOO_GOOD_RETURNS.label: Returns too good to be true
TOO_GOOD_RETURNS.detail: Promises guaranteed or very high returns.

TASK_JOB_PAYMENT.label: Paid online tasks
TASK_JOB_PAYMENT.detail: Offers money for easy online tasks. These usually end with you paying them.

WRONG_TRANSFER_RETURN.label: "Sent by mistake" or refund
WRONG_TRANSFER_RETURN.detail: Asks you to return money "sent by mistake" or act on a refund.

CUSTOMER_CARE_NUMBER.label: Unknown helpline number
CUSTOMER_CARE_NUMBER.detail: Gives a "customer care" number in a message you did not expect.

BANK_IMPERSONATION.label: Pretends to be a bank
BANK_IMPERSONATION.detail: Uses a bank name or KYC with an urgent account action.

BRAND_MISMATCH.label: Doesn't match the brand
BRAND_MISMATCH.detail: Claims to be a known brand, but the link or sender is not theirs.

UPI_NAME_MISMATCH.label: Name doesn't match the UPI ID
UPI_NAME_MISMATCH.detail: The name claims a brand, but the UPI ID looks personal.

PERSONAL_UPI_HANDLE.label: Personal UPI ID
PERSONAL_UPI_HANDLE.detail: A bank or business would not use a personal UPI ID.

REPLY_TO_MISMATCH.label: Replies go elsewhere
REPLY_TO_MISMATCH.detail: Your reply would go to a different address than the sender.

SUSPICIOUS_LINK.label: Suspicious link
SUSPICIOUS_LINK.detail: The link is not an official site of the sender it names.

LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN.label: Lookalike web address
LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN.detail: The address imitates a real brand or bank.

SHORTENED_URL.label: Shortened link
SHORTENED_URL.detail: A short link hides where it really goes.

IP_URL.label: Link is a number address
IP_URL.detail: Real services use names, not raw number addresses.

RISKY_TLD.label: Unusual web address ending
RISKY_TLD.detail: This ending is cheap and often used for scam sites.

PUNYCODE.label: Disguised letters in the address
PUNYCODE.detail: The address uses look-alike letters from other alphabets.

NEW_DOMAIN.label: Very new website
NEW_DOMAIN.detail: This website was registered only recently.

REDIRECT_CHAIN.label: Link redirects
REDIRECT_CHAIN.detail: The link jumps through several addresses.

RISKY_ATTACHMENT.label: Risky attachment
RISKY_ATTACHMENT.detail: Files like .apk, .exe or .html can install malware or open fake pages.

PREFILLED_AMOUNT.label: Amount already filled in
PREFILLED_AMOUNT.detail: The payment amount is already filled in for you.

OBFUSCATION.label: Disguised wording
OBFUSCATION.detail: Words are split up or misspelt to get past filters.

ESCALATION.label: Pressure builds up
ESCALATION.detail: The chat moves from a problem to a link, an app or a payment.

KNOWN_INDICATOR.label: Reported before
KNOWN_INDICATOR.detail: This number, UPI ID or website appears in scam reports (sample data).

BLOCKLISTED.label: You blocked this
BLOCKLISTED.detail: You added this to your block list.

MODEL_PATTERN.label: Wording seen in scams
MODEL_PATTERN.detail: Wording seen in many scam messages.

AI_FLAG.label: AI second opinion
AI_FLAG.detail: The AI check flagged this part.

SAFETY_ADVICE.label: Real safety advice
SAFETY_ADVICE.detail: Genuine bank messages remind you never to share your OTP.

OFFICIAL_DOMAIN.label: Official website
OFFICIAL_DOMAIN.detail: Every link goes to an official site of the brand it names.

upi_collect.name: UPI collect-request trap
upi_collect.oneLiner: A request that takes money when you enter your PIN.

qr_receive.name: QR "receive money" trap
qr_receive.oneLiner: A QR code that pays the scammer when you scan it.

fake_kyc.name: Fake KYC update
fake_kyc.oneLiner: A fake warning that your account will be blocked without KYC.

bill_disconnection.name: Bill disconnection threat
bill_disconnection.oneLiner: A fake warning that your power, gas or phone will be cut.

digital_arrest.name: "Digital arrest"
digital_arrest.oneLiner: Fake police or officials who threaten arrest over a call.

courier_customs.name: Courier or customs scam
courier_customs.oneLiner: A fake parcel problem that needs a fee or your details.

job_task.name: Task or job scam
job_task.oneLiner: Easy online work that ends with you paying them.

investment_crypto.name: Investment or crypto scam
investment_crypto.oneLiner: Promises of guaranteed high returns that do not exist.

loan_app.name: Loan app scam
loan_app.oneLiner: Instant loans with hidden fees or harassment.

lottery_prize.name: Lottery or prize scam
lottery_prize.oneLiner: A prize you never entered that needs a fee first.

fake_customer_care.name: Fake customer care
fake_customer_care.oneLiner: A fake helpline that asks for access to your phone or a payment.

refund_cashback.name: Refund or cashback scam
refund_cashback.oneLiner: A fake refund that makes you pay instead.

wrong_transfer.name: "Sent by mistake" scam
wrong_transfer.oneLiner: A request to return money that was never really sent.

malicious_apk.name: Harmful app (APK)
malicious_apk.oneLiner: An app file that can read your messages and OTPs.

remote_access.name: Screen-sharing scam
remote_access.oneLiner: An app that lets a stranger control your phone.

otp_theft.name: OTP theft
otp_theft.oneLiner: An attempt to get the one-time code that approves payments.

romance.name: Romance scam
romance.oneLiner: A friendship or relationship that turns into requests for money.

impersonation_govt.name: Government impersonation
impersonation_govt.oneLiner: Someone pretending to be a government department.

phishing_link.name: Phishing link
phishing_link.oneLiner: A fake website that steals logins or card details.

other.name: Other scam
other.oneLiner: Shows signs of a scam that does not fit a common pattern.

decline_request.label: Decline the request
decline_request.body: In your UPI app, tap Decline. Never enter your PIN to receive money.

block_sender.label: Block the sender
block_sender.body: Block the number or UPI ID. Akshi Rakshak will also warn you if it appears again.

do_not_click.label: Don't open the link
do_not_click.body: Do not tap the link or type any details on that site.

do_not_pay.label: Don't pay
do_not_pay.body: Do not send money, scan a QR or approve any request.

do_not_share_otp.label: Don't share any OTP
do_not_share_otp.body: No bank, company or officer ever needs your OTP or PIN.

do_not_install.label: Don't install the app
do_not_install.body: Do not install apps from links or share your screen.

end_call.label: End the call
end_call.body: Hang up. Real officials never threaten arrest over a phone or video call.

verify_official.label: Check with the official source
verify_official.body: Use the number on your card or the official app or website, not the one in the message.

report_chakshu.label: Report on Chakshu
report_chakshu.body: Report the suspicious call or message on Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu).

report_1930.label: Call 1930
report_1930.body: If money left your account, call the cyber crime helpline 1930 right away.

report_cybercrime_portal.label: Report at cybercrime.gov.in
report_cybercrime_portal.body: File a complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.

call_bank.label: Call your bank
call_bank.body: Use the number on your card or in your bank's official app.

warn_family.label: Warn your family
warn_family.body: Share a warning so others do not fall for the same message.

emergency.label: I already paid or shared details
emergency.body: Open the emergency checklist now. Acting fast matters.

no_action_needed.label: No action needed
no_action_needed.body: No warning signs found. Still, never share your OTP or PIN with anyone.
